title: cyclosorus elmerorum
intro: Cyclosorus elmerorum, commonly known as Elmer's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its distinctive fronds and reproductive structures. The health benefits of Cyclosorus elmerorum include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities.
